body:
After a long terrifying and eye-opening night all ending here babysitting with this cup of caffeine-free Lemon Tea and a cig with some more A-PVP smoked on the side. I will try to explain my experience to the best of my ability.
After getting off work I started to try the IV technique with about 3-5mg a-PVP powder. Can say the effects were not what I expected, nice come on except for some mild discomfort in the chest but this soon passed, a numbing effect due to its potency.
That was administered on a empty stomach at around 8:45pm and then continued moderate use of the a-PVP over the course of the next 2 hours going through about 20mg personally of the a-PVP, still no substance besides water and ginger ale.
At this point I realised I had three 100mcg hits of 1P-LSD blotter still left so I ingested a 1000mcg vitamin C supplement pill and took 300mcg of the 1P-LSD around 11:20/11:30. The effects became apparent well before the first wave of visuals. Massively intense body high and body temperature to the point were I bit off more than I could chew, having too much stimulant in me already and malnourished my heart was skipping and wise-ling tunes as the over intensified visuals came on due in part to the vitamin C supplement being digested so soon. Due to the extensive pulse and blood pressure I was surely receiving loss of feeling and numbness in my left arm and body all the way through the intense visuals of lights and sounds pouring through the mirror at me and due to the extensiveness of my heart rate. The psychoactive stimulation caused me not only physical fear but un abundant awe at the blur of sounds and lights rapping around the mirrors and picture frames and the tv screen morphing onto the wall. I actually was believing I received a Aldous Huxley Finale BE@utiful trip to the after life. Thank god I made it more or less still breathing and, being, and dreaming though all to soon parallel dream.
Can actually say besides the heart attack scare that was one of the most beautiful intense trips I have yet to experience, can say it would be beneficial to take A-PVP wile peaking or on the come up ( Will definitely do again) *Only with more nutritional and prepared method e.g. since I can't control a psychoactive effects.
My next experiment will  be to administer the blotter sober then as I am coming up try a blast then again at the peak. Instead of beforehand. Can say in moderate doses equilibrium has made itself attained besides the expected jitters, colliding thoughts, and clamminess / back ache under extreme use.
